explained.?: The Qt toolbar's '?' button. The emtk app has a 'Help' button (same help.md) next to 'Guide', in the Toolbar window.
explained.blend: Option of a drop-down. The inventory reads the options of the Qt combo's hidden item view; the emtk combo lists them only while it is open (after_expanded_1200x800.png shows the current value). The option is in the spec's 'options' / 'labels'.
explained.blur: Internal of the pyqtgraph ImageView the Qt image windows used (time/frame slider, blur, mean, ROI and operation buttons, axis labels). Not ported: the native windows use chisurf.emtk.image_canvas.ImageCanvas (pan/zoom, colormap, gamma, levels, reset view), which has no time axis or image arithmetic; these maps are single 2D arrays.
explained.cividis: Not ported: the shared ImageCanvas offers magma, inferno, viridis and gray only.
explained.colormap: Colormap control of the image windows. The emtk ImageCanvas draws its 'Colormap' drop-down once an image exists (populated state: after_populated_*.png); the empty-state after.json does not list it.
explained.cps: Field inside a fold that starts closed, as in the Qt tool (Kinetics (advanced), 1D-MEM + Gaussian, Simulator); the fold opens on a click or when the guide points at it. Drawn in after_expanded_1200x800.png and listed in the native spec.
